dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curvature following a simple spline from the posterior insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius, classified as obtuse-rounded.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50 to 60 degree incline relative to the horizontal midline of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.3 times the vertical height from the dorsal ridge.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Gradual, large-radius convexity extending from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Extremely short and thick protrusion, characterized by low length-to-depth ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Subtle, obtuse interior angle at the transition point between the melon and the rostrum.
